description: Move a confirmed booking to a new start time with the same staff member, as the business does in the Forms app: Replo emails the person the new time, resets the reminder and moves the calendar event. The new time may fall outside opening hours, but not on top of another booking. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

startsAt.description: The new start; the booking keeps its staff member and length, and may fall outside opening hours

name: replo_bookings_reschedule
title: Reschedule a booking
